blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ فَارَقَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَي اْلإِخْلَاصِ لِلّهِ وَحْدَهُ لَاشَرِيكَ لَهُ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، فَارَقَهَا وَاللهُ عَنْهُ رَاضٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٢ /٣٣٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever leaves the world having lived with sincerity for Allah, the One who has no partner, having kept up Salah, and having paid Zakat (if he was a man of means), he will leave the world in a state where Allah is pleased with him.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- Being sincere (ikhlas) for Allah means choosing, with the heart, obedience to Allah.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ أَخْلَصَ قَلْبَهُ لِلْإِيمَانِ وَجَعَلَ قَلْبَهُ سَلِيماً وَلِسَانَهُ صَادِقاً وَنَفْسَهُ مُطْمَئِنَّةً وَخَلِيقَتَهُ مُسْتَقِيمَةً وَجَعَلَ أُذُنَهُ مُسْتَمِعَةً وَعَيْنَهُ نَاظِرَةً.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever purified his heart for Iman (from kufr and shirk), made it tranquil (free from love of the world), made his tongue truthful, made his nafs content (through the remembrance of Allah and by acting according to His pleasure), set his character straight (without inclining towards evils), made his ears such that they listen with readiness to accept (good things), and made his eyes such that they look (attentively at good things), has certainly succeeded.”
